record.context_brief: page number of complete bipartite graphs
record.original_question: Determine the page number of every complete bipartite graph K_{r,s}, where the page number is the minimum number of pages in a book embedding with all vertices on the spine.

evidence.quote: Problem 7.5 Find the page number of Kr,s .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A $k$-page book embedding of a graph $G$ consists of a linear ordering of the vertices of $G$ along a line (the spine) together with an assignment of each edge to one of $k$ half-planes (pages) bounded by the spine, in such a way that within each page no two edges cross (equivalently, no two edges assigned to the same page have endpoints that alternate along the spine). The page number (or book thickness) $\mathrm{pn}(G)$ of $G$ is the minimum $k$ for which such an embedding exists.

Let $K_{r,s}$ denote the complete bipartite graph with parts of sizes $r$ and $s$. Determine $\mathrm{pn}(K_{r,s})$ as an exact function of $r$ and $s$ for all positive integers $r, s$.
artifact.status_search_result: The exact page number of $K_{r,s}$ remains unknown in general. Partial results are known: Muder, Weaver, and West (1988) and subsequent work give upper bounds such as $\mathrm{pn}(K_{m,n}) \le \lceil (m+2n)/4 \rceil$ (conjectured optimal), $\mathrm{pn}(K_{n,n}) \le \lfloor 2n/3 \rfloor + 1$, and the asymptotic identity $\min\{m : \mathrm{pn}(K_{m,n}) = n\} = n^2/4 + O(n^{7/4})$ due to Enomoto, Nakamigawa, and Ota. Exact values are known only for small or special cases (e.g., $\mathrm{pn}(K_{4,4}) = 3$).

status_evidence.title: Pagenumber of complete bipartite graphs - Muder, Weaver, West
status_evidence.snippet: Upper bound pn(K_{m,n}) ≤ ⌈(m+2n)/4⌉ conjectured optimal; exact values only in some cases.
status_evidence.claim: The exact page number of K_{r,s} is unresolved; only bounds and partial results are known.

status_evidence.title: On the Pagenumber of Complete Bipartite Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Enomoto, Nakamigawa, Ota: min{m: p(K_{m,n})=n} = n^2/4 + O(n^{7/4}).
status_evidence.claim: Asymptotic but not exact determination of the page number of K_{r,s}.

status_evidence.title: Book embedding - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Book thickness of K_{a,b} is at most min(a,b), but not always tight; e.g., K_{4,4} has book thickness three.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial/exact results for special K_{r,s} are documented.
